_doc: LNT1: shared ambiguous-phrasing table. Read by resolver/core/tests/lint_parity.rs and apps/web/tests/lintParity.unit.test.ts. Each ambiguous case must be refused by BOTH the resolver custom lint and the web builder gate with the SAME problem code; every control must produce no AMBIGUOUS_*/CUSTOM_RELATIVE_DATE problem in either. full_pass controls must also have ZERO problems from the web builder gate on a filled-in non-price form.
